Midnight Navy Muay Thai & Kickboxing Shorts

A traditional wide-leg striking-short direction with a midnight navy satin-look surface, multi-row gathered waistband and black-bound side openings. Develop your own gym, academy or private-label version with TONTON, then approve the fabric, fit and branding on a physical sample.

  • Traditional wide gathered elastic waist
  • Wide-leg cut with black-bound side openings
  • Midnight navy satin-look finish and white logo placement
  • Private-label development for brands, gyms and teams
Request Custom Muay Thai Shorts

Front, back and on-body design views

Supplied design references show the intended appearance and branding placement. Confirm fabric, measurements and finishing against the physical sample.

Construction choices for custom kickboxing shorts

Traditional gathered waistband

A broad elastic waist with multiple horizontal stitch rows defines the reference design. Confirm relaxed and stretched waist measurements, elastic recovery and wearer comfort during sampling.

High side openings for striking movement

Wide legs and black-bound side openings provide a mobility-focused cut for Muay Thai and kickboxing. Agree the split height, finished length and reinforcement details on the approved pattern.

Midnight navy satin-look surface

The supplied images show a smooth, softly lustrous navy shell. Confirm fiber composition, fabric weight, stretch and drying requirements before production.

Private-label branding placement

Review the front waistband patch, white lower-leg crest and vertical rear lettering as placement references. Confirm your logo files, print or label technique, scale and colour on the sample.

Agree the seam construction, bar-tack reinforcement, waistband patch technique and performance requirements during sampling. Composition, GSM, drying, abrasion and colourfastness need a confirmed material specification and agreed checks.

Custom Muay Thai shorts: buyer questions

Can these navy Muay Thai shorts be customized for a gym or brand?

Use this design as a development reference for your own artwork, waistband label and size plan. Confirm the fabric, panel layout, decoration and measurements through a mockup and physical sample.

How do Muay Thai shorts differ from 2-in-1 grappling shorts?

This reference uses a wide-leg striking-short silhouette and side openings. A 2-in-1 grappling short adds a fitted inner layer. Select the construction according to coverage, movement and training requirements; no liner is confirmed for this reference.

What is the material and GSM?

The images show a satin-look shell, but final fiber composition and GSM have not been confirmed. Request the actual fabric specification and inspect the material before approving bulk production.

What should I send for a custom Muay Thai shorts quotation?

Send artwork, estimated quantity by size, target measurements, waistband and split preferences, labels, delivery country and target timing. MOQ, sample timing and pricing depend on the confirmed brief.

Is the video real product test footage?

The supplied video is a generated promotional visualization. Use the approved physical sample to assess fit, materials, movement and construction.

Develop your gym or private-label striking collection

Send your logo, quantity by size, fabric preference, finished length, waistband direction and delivery country. TONTON will review your custom Muay Thai or kickboxing shorts brief and sample plan.
